title: Web export AudioPlayer with stream playback type causes unhandled wasm error on get_tree().paused = true and on autostart for composite audio streams
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.1-stable
- Not reproducible 4.3-stable
(Instead it gives a `USER WARNING: /root/World/AudioStreamPlayer is trying to play a sample from a stream that cannot be sampled.`)


### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 04 Aug 2025 06:57:08 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, renoir, ACO, DRM 3.63, 6.15.9-arch1-1.1-g14) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HX with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

Pausing the scene tree with a playing AudioStreamPlayer/2d/3d with playback type `sample` and a stream type of `AudioStreamPlaylist`/`AudioStreamInteractive`/`AudioStreamSynchronized` causes an unhandled wasm error, causing the rest of the function after that point to not execute.

The wasm error is very hard to debug since there's no source map to gdscript.

Changing the playback type for web export back to `stream` is a workaround/fix for this issue.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the MRP
- Install Export Template (if missing)
- Click "Run in Web Browser"
- Open Browser Dev Console
- Toggle pause by pressing Enter, toggle music by moving left or right
- See the console error when you try to pause when the music is playing
- (Optional) change the audio streams between AudioStreamPlaylist, AudioStreamInteractive & AudioStreamSynchronized
- (Optional) change autostart to true and rerun the project

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[example.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21833577/example.zip)
